title: Sloane's Gap - Numberphile
summary: A Numberphile video with Dr James Grime on Sloane's Gap, the observation that integers in the OEIS are not evenly represented and some numbers are underrepresented. It explains the clusters of 'interesting' numbers.
why: HN recommends it as a concise, quick explanation of the OEIS pattern when threads touch the integer sequence encyclopedia.

quote.text: Very good video on Sloane's Gap, for the impatient
